The '''Guardian of the Inner Sanctum''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|Commando]] who was part of the [[Shrine of Healing]]'s guard detail during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed at the door to the inner sanctum of the shrine.<ref name="TOR" />
